stage1.impression: A competent, warm, low-key CG interior: board ceiling, a record wall, a fluted counter and pendants in pools of light, but at 1:1 the surfaces are smooth and CG (an orange-plastic fir ceiling, a matte grey counter top, a blotchy smeared floor). The coloured globe hanging at top left reads as a 3D-software rotate gizmo, thin flat-coloured rings with almost no acrylic body, and it is cut off by the frame. Without it the room is a generic dark wood-and-records bar that a magazine would not run as a specific place; with it as rendered, it reads as a render.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as six thick cast-acrylic discs with visible faces, glowing polished rims and a hard coloured shadow on the concrete wall; now it reads as thin emissive wireframe rings (a rotate gizmo), and its shadow on the wall is neutral grey (region 70,260,140,420: r84 g59 b52)
Mother EARF wholly in frame with air around it, not cropped by the top and left edges and not overlapping the framed poster
The Tropos speakers read as the hero tinted-acrylic product at a glance; the one in view (920,260,1010,450) reads as a generic black studio monitor
The centre of the frame (the shopfront and street, 330,300,650,540, lum_median 11) holds detail and a sense of the street at night instead of a dead black hole

Materials at 1:1: the zinc top reads as zinc (soft uneven sheen, specular from the Domes), the floor as polished concrete without large smeared blotches, the fir ceiling as timber rather than orange plastic
No odd diagonal light shafts on the ceiling (440,40,540,110 and 780,60,830,200)
Something specific to this bar in the hero view (the decks, EARFcoins, altar) legible enough that it could not be any other bar

defects.what: Mother EARF reads as a rotate gizmo: uniform flat-coloured thin rim lines, near-invisible disc faces, only about four of six colours legible (orange and violet nearly lost); cut by the frame's top and left edges
the globe's shadow on the wall and poster is soft and neutral grey, not coloured; it falls on a framed poster, which muddles it
the back-bar speaker reads as a black studio monitor; the smoked tint, the acrylic and the white batts inside do not read
the centre of the frame is a near-black void (lum_median 11.1); the shopfront glass and street are illegible
the concrete floor has large blotchy smeared stains and vein-like cracks that read as a texture smeared by the denoiser, not as a polished slab
the zinc counter top reads as matte grey plaster or plastic, with no metal sheen and no reflection of the Domes or the glasses
the fir ceiling is saturated orange (r67 g32 b15), plastic-smooth, with no checks or nail holes
a diagonal haze light shaft hitting the ceiling, from no visible source
a second diagonal haze shaft beside a pendant cord, which reads as an artifact
the Dome pendants read as white opal milk glass; the smoked tint and frosted liner are not legible
a pinkish-magenta cast on the counter's fluted front from the under-glow, against an otherwise warm-amber grade
a foreground counter chair cut by the bottom-right corner; the 24 mm lens stretches the foreground stools
an Orb at the left edge is clipped near white (lum_median 235) and cut by the frame

changes.problem: The globe's rims glow as flat, uniform lines while its disc faces are invisible, so the centrepiece reads as a software gizmo rather than 25 mm cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: globe region lum_median 27.3; the area inside the rims is about the same as the ceiling behind it; the rims are saturated lines about 6 px wide with no gradient along them

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, and its hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.025; hard spot 135.0 W, cone 20.0 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.012; hard spot 260 W, cone 14 deg, so the faces catch light, show tint and reflections, and the rims glow from light carried through the acrylic rather than from emission

changes.expected: The disc faces become visible as tinted translucent planes with a specular sweep, the rims glow brighter where the spot enters, all six colours become legible, and the gizmo read goes away.

changes.problem: The globe is cropped by the top and left edges and overlaps the framed poster, and a foreground stool is cut by the bottom-right corner.

evidence.measured: the globe's rim touches x about 45 and y about 60; the shadow falls across the poster at 45-165 x 190-440

change.to: position [11.0, 2.8, 1.35], target [4.6, 3.0, 1.75], 24 mm (back about 0.65 m, slightly lower, aim tilted up and toward the globe so it sits whole in the upper-left third with clear wall around its shadow); keep verticals true with a shift rather than a tilt if possible

changes.expected: The globe sits fully in frame with its coloured shadow on bare concrete, and the counter still leads the eye to the shopfront.

changes.problem: The globe's shadow on the wall is soft and grey, so the coloured-shadow idea, the centrepiece's whole point, does not read.

evidence.measured: r84 g59 b52, lum_median 64.4, lum_p95 87.2: a low-contrast neutral shadow

change.setting: the hard spot's position and size, and the fill on that wall
change.from: hard spot from [6.24, 2.75, 3.32], soft; the Orbs and room bounce flatten the wall
change.to: hard spot moved to [6.6, 2.9, 3.35] with radius 0 (a point source) so the shadow is crisp and lands on bare concrete beside the poster; Orb glow 0.012 to 0.008 to cut the fill on that wall

changes.expected: A crisp shadow with coloured fringes and tinted patches where light passes through the discs, at least 2:1 against the lit wall around it.

changes.problem: The shopfront and street at the vanishing point are a black void, so the frame has no depth or destination and reads as a box.

change.setting: street lamps; the window's etched name
change.to: 2 street lamps outside the glass, 2700 K sodium-warm, enough to rim the mullions and silhouette a parked car or a tree; etched name 0.02

changes.expected: The shopfront reads as glass with a dim street beyond it; the centre lifts out of black while staying the darkest zone.

changes.problem: The Tropos in the back-bar niche reads as a black studio monitor; its smoked acrylic, the batts inside and its horn are not legible, so EARF's product is not the hero.

evidence.measured: lum_median 55.8, r74 g52 b41; the cabinet itself reads as an opaque near-black box

change.setting: on each Ember speaker, area lamps; the lit niche's strip
change.from: 1.0 W/m2 at the target, 2900 K; niche strip 6.0
change.to: 2.5 W/m2, raking from above and behind so light passes through the acrylic walls; niche strip 9.0

changes.expected: The cabinet's translucency and the white batts read through the smoke tint; the horn has a highlight on its lip.

changes.problem: The zinc counter top reads as matte grey plaster, which wastes the sculpted counter, the frame's leading line.

evidence.measured: lum_median 77.2 with a flat grey; no specular reflections of the Domes, glasses or candles visible in the crop

change.to: roughness about 0.28 with low-frequency variation of plus or minus 0.1 (wipe marks), metallic 1, a slightly darker blue-grey base

changes.expected: Soft, broad reflections of the Domes and candles run along the top, which reads as worn zinc.

changes.problem: The grade is too orange: the fir ceiling reads as orange plastic and the timber loses its grain colour.
changes.expected: The ceiling moves toward a brown, dark-amber fir and stays warm; the concrete greys read as warm grey rather than tan.

changes.problem: The concrete floor shows large blotchy stains and dark vein lines that read as a smeared CG texture, and diagonal haze shafts hit the ceiling from no visible source.

evidence.measured: lum_median 29.3 with large blotches of plus or minus about 15 at 50 to 150 px scale; shafts at 440,40,540,110 (lum_p95 78) and 780,60,830,200 (lum_p95 149)

change.to: floor polish up (roughness about 0.35) with the stain contrast halved so reflections of the counter glow and the Orbs carry the floor instead of the stains; haze 0.002

changes.expected: The floor reads as a sealed concrete slab with soft pools reflected from the lamps; the ceiling shafts fade below notice.

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's six discs thicker or more visible, or reduce its saturated colours so the room keeps one colour
out_of_scope.why: The globe's design and the colours are fixed by the owner; only its lighting and the room's light can change (c1, c3).

out_of_scope.request: Give the Dome pendants a more visibly smoked tint instead of white opal
out_of_scope.why: The products' colour and parts are fixed; only their glow levels may change, and they are not the frame's main problem.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the framed poster under the globe with bare concrete
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show are part of the fixed room design; the camera move (c2) and the spot's position (c3) work around it.

out_of_scope.request: On whether a magazine would run this as a specific place: as framed, it reads as a generic dark wood-and-records bar
out_of_scope.why: The specific elements (the globe, the Tropos, the decks, the EARFcoins) are present but illegible or read as CG. The fixes above are lighting and camera, not design, so no design change is requested.
